instruction: A blocky voxel-art robot character built entirely from unit cubes (Minecraft/Crossy-Road aesthetic): a cube head with two glowing square eyes, a boxy torso with a small chest panel, rectangular blocky arms and legs, and an antenna made of stacked cubes.
